technical_review.notes: Schema validation flags related to required capabilities are noted, but all internal objectives, modules, and lessons map correctly[cite: 25].

special_question.answer: YES. A very strong, highly integrated technical curriculum that respects operational dependencies.
special_question.notes: The design excellently maps the physical reality of construction (reading plans -> sequencing work -> ensuring safety) into a coherent learning path[cite: 25].

rubric_scores.rationale: Criteria like 'identifies at least four distinct drawing element categories' and 'states at least two safety considerations' are highly objective and measurable[cite: 25].
The integrated written performance task requires learners to execute all three objectives simultaneously, mirroring the brief[cite: 25].
Working directly from a basic construction drawing set ensures authentic, high-fidelity assessment evidence[cite: 25].
The progression from 'understand' (interpreting elements) to 'apply' (sequencing methods and identifying safety) is perfectly calibrated[cite: 25].
Recognizing that basic drawing conventions must be a prerequisite ensures the 60 minutes are spent on interpretation and method planning, not basic symbol literacy[cite: 25].
The instructional sequence (Read -> Sequence -> Safety) is logically air-tight and reflects standard industry practice[cite: 25].
The use of worked examples and an integrated scenario effectively prepares the learner for the summative submission[cite: 25].
Fast-paced, but possible within 60 minutes if the sample drawing is kept extremely simple and focused[cite: 25].
Strictly limited to the scope of the drawing set; explicitly excludes general site safety to prevent scope creep[cite: 25].
Only minor effort required to calibrate the complexity of the drawing fixture to ensure it fits the time limit.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: The prerequisite is well-defined and essential[cite: 25].

edit_effort.notes: No structural edits required. The researcher must carefully select an appropriately simple construction drawing fixture[cite: 25].

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: A rigorous, authentic, and highly logical instructional design that beautifully integrates three distinct construction competencies into a single unified performance task[cite: 25].
